thread:
June: Quick thread 10k benchmark webinar next week. Need X teaser (single-image + 2 caption tones), LinkedIn long post + stat card, 12s story clip, and routing for registrants. Can someone own creative + routing? @Rory?

Rory: I can do creative. Drop the final toplines and logo. Prefer PNG 1200x1200 + MP4 1080x1080.

Sam: Toplines in drive: https://drive.redwood.ai/bench/jun_release. Key: ~58% latency drop, 2.2x throughput, ~29% cost reduction. Logo pack at /assets/logos.zip

June: Routing: tag leads `bench_jun_webinar` and route to `webinar-sdr-rotation`. UTM: utm_campaign=bench_jun&utm_source=social&utm_medium=organic; utm_content set per format. @Nia can you add rule + staging test?

Nia: On it. Will add rule, set prefill ref=bench_jun, and run a staging mapping test. Will post results.

Scheduler-bot: Suggested publish slots Mon/Tue 11:00 PT. Console slot available Mon 11:00 PT.

Rory: Creative ETA Wed noon. Will include alt colorway + accessibility alt text.

Sam: Copy guidance: X variant A benefit-led, B technical. LinkedIn: 3-paragraph narrative + PM quote. Sam will drop drafts by Tue EOD.

Nia: Staging test passed at 15:12 PT  sample routed to `webinar-sdr-rotation-staging` with utm_content=x_teaser.

June: Plan: Mon 11:00 PT X teaser (variant A), Tue 11:00 PT LinkedIn long + stat card, Wed 09:00 PT X reminder + register CTA. If 24h CTR < 1% flip to "Watch on demand" and pin stat card.

Rory: Uploaded assets to drive and pinged.

Sam: Copy drafts posted. small stat tweak: use "~58%" to reflect sample.

Nia: Will run prod smoke after publish and confirm routing.

June: Thanks team  closing once smoke test passes and posts queued.
